method: Exact enumeration and independent algebra; narrative scope reviewed separately.
proof: For radius R and bore a, b²=R²-a² and h=2b. Slice at z has area π(R²-z²-a²)=π(b²-z²), equal to a radius-b sphere slice. Cavalieri gives equal volumes, 4πb³/3=πh³/6. Annular visuals are axonometric illustrations, not photographs.
